app.name: XLSmart Customer Activity
app.short_description: Customer profile, activity timeline, and voucher actions in the ticket sidebar.
app.long_description: Shows the customer profile behind an activity ticket, the live interaction timeline, and any active voucher, and lets an agent issue or resend a time-limited voucher in one click.

internalToken.label: Internal token
internalToken.helpText: Shared secret sent as X-Internal-Token to apps/api's internal endpoints
